task_description: Place the four Task 3 mock-service Lambdas behind one Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway and expose their 25 operations as MCP tools, preserving data equivalence and the six-write HITL gate. Add a dual-mode (DIRECT default | GATEWAY) toggle to the Strands agent, a mandatory Gateway->Router adapter in each Lambda, a native CDK MahaloGatewayStack, new unit tests, and an offline verification gate. Live deploy/auth steps are deferred to a human operator.
